group.label: Memoirs · Journal of a Newbie Officer

lines.text: Today, I saw the Goddess Squad's commander at headquarters.
He was walking down the hall with Major Liliweiss.
I was so overwhelmed by his presence that I couldn't even bring myself to speak to him, let alone ask for an autograph.
I wish I'd at least taken a picture from afar.
I couldn't make out what they were talking about, but it didn't look like they were talking about a mission. The Major was smiling.
Later, while I was working, I came across an assessment report on the Goddess Squad's commander.
Apparently, he's disobeyed the higher-ups' orders more than once.
And yet, every time, he's managed to achieve even greater results by trusting his own judgment and making it back alive.
If I'd been in his position, could I put my own judgment in the field above my orders? Probably not.
Today, my idol feels more out of reach than ever.
